source: hand-built, not NRS data: a few UN/ECE Recommendation 20 unit codes

data.name: one
data.description: A unit of count defining the number of pieces (piece: a single item, article or exemplar).

data.name: each
data.description: A unit of count defining the number of each (each: a single item, article or exemplar).

data.name: hour
data.description: A unit of time equal to 3600 seconds.

data.name: kilogram
data.description: A unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.

data.name: litre
data.description: A unit of volume equal to one cubic decimetre.

data.name: metre
data.description: A unit of length equal to the distance travelled by light in 1/299792458 second.

data.name: box
data.description: A unit of count defining the number of boxes.
